To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a new method for estimating the change point in a variance function based on a local likelihood function is proposed.
the proposed method provides an efficient estimation of the variance function with a change point.

we propose a new approach for estimation of change points in the variance function in a regression model based on a one-side kernel-weighted local likelihood function which is provided the χ2-distributed random variable.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the estimation of a change point of a regression model based on the χ²-distribution.
the estimation of a change point and the whole log-variance structure in the variance function of a regression model.
the estimation of a change point for the log-variance in a regression model.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the method is very efficient for detecting the location of the change point and for estimating the whole log-variance function.
the proposed method can be used to estimate a change point in a regression model with a discontinuous variance function.
the proposed methods are effective and robust in estimating the change/discontinuity points in variance functions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed method can be used as an alternative to the traditional methods in the case of the variance functions with discontinuities.
we provide an estimation method for change point in the log-variance functions based on the χ^2-distribution.
the method is applicable to the estimation of the location and the size of the change points of variance functions in the regression models.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the χ2-based estimators are competitive to the existing ones.
the proposed methods can estimate the change point and the jump size accurately even when the sample size is small, and the proposed methods are more efficient than the existing methods.
we can detect and estimate the change point in the regression models with the log-variance functions which are discontinuous or have jumps.
